editions.label: 數位版
editions.contentSummary: 固定版式 EPUB 數位寫真。Readmoo 書目列 T妹與攝影師戴群芳；頁數與完整造型／影像清單未標示。三民頁面簡介誤貼成 Chris 子婷／方糖兒的作品介紹，未用該段文字推定本書內容。

findings: Sanmin live page confirmed title, author T妹, ISBN/EISBN 9789571095622, Sharp Point, 2019-09-20, fixed-layout EPUB, NT$239, and add-to-cart control.

Readmoo's indexed product detail identifies T妹 and photographer 戴群芳 and agrees on ISBN/EISBN 9789571095622; opening the prior Readmoo URL now redirects to a service-upgrade notice, so no Readmoo offer was imported.
BOOK☆WALKER search indexing lists the same digital title at NT$189, but its product page was not independently live-verified; no BOOK☆WALKER price was imported.

The National Central Library new-books PDF lists the same title and creators but ISBN 9789571096544, conflicting with both retailer EISBN listings. The verified retailer EISBN 9789571095622 is stored; the NCL discrepancy is retained here, not created as a second edition.
Sanmin's long product description is copied from Chris 子婷／方糖兒's book and conflicts with the title and author fields. It was excluded from this book's composition metadata.
No public completed-sale transaction price or verified physical edition was found for this title.
